neighbours.label: the word just before a remedy in return/refund policies (can [accept a refund], asked for [another], issue an [exchange], returned for [refund])
fire: If the item arrives damaged, we can offer a full refund or a replacement.
Unworn shoes may be returned for a refund within thirty days.
The towel was stained, so I asked for a new one at the front desk.
We can only issue an exchange if the product is faulty.
If you are not satisfied with the repair, we will redo it at no cost.
Customers who were overcharged will receive a credit on their next bill.
The seller agreed to send a replacement after I complained about the crack.
Defective chargers can be exchanged for a working unit at any store.
quiet: If the item arrives on time, please leave a review on our website.
Unworn shoes look best when stored in their original box.
The towel was soft, so I asked where they bought it at the front desk.
We can only ship the product within the country at the moment.
If you are happy with the repair, please tell your friends about us.
Customers who pay early will see the date on their next bill.
The seller agreed to send photos of the vase before I bought it.
Phone chargers can be bought in three colours at any store.

notes: card: top examples all in customer-service remedy statements; peak sits on the function word before 'refund'/'exchange'/'another one'/'fix it'. Quiet keeps shop/service text without a remedy being offered.
